title: General Manager - Operations
description:
Role Purpose The General Manager is responsible for end-to-end management of the 55-room resort, balancing hands-on operational leadership with strategic oversight. The role demands a strong understanding of resort operations, destination hospitality, guest engagement, and owner relations , particularly in a hill / nature destination. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Resort Operations & Leadership Lead all operational departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, Engineering, Security, Landscaping, Activities, and Spa/Recreation (if applicable). Ensure smooth day-to-day operations with a strong on-ground presence and visibility. Implement and monitor SOPs in line with Saj brand standards and service philosophy. Ensure full compliance with local laws, excise regulations, pollution norms, safety standards, and statutory requirements relevant to Maharashtra hill destinations. 
 2. Guest Experience & Brand Representation Deliver a warm, personalized, and memorable guest experience aligned with Sajs hospitality ethos. Actively interact with guests, handle escalations, and convert complaints into loyalty opportunities. Monitor online reviews (OTA, Google, social platforms) and drive continuous improvement in guest satisfaction scores. Position the resort as a preferred destination for weekend getaways, celebrations, and retreats. 
 3. Financial & Business Performance Prepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts, and operating plans. Drive profitability through effective cost control, inventory management, and revenue optimization. Analyze P&L, MIS reports, and KPIs; take corrective actions where required. Ensure optimal pricing, yield management, and package creation for peak and lean seasons. 
 4. Sales, Marketing & Revenue Generation Drive room, F&B, and ancillary revenues through targeted sales initiatives. Develop and promote destination weddings, social events, corporate offsites, and experiential packages. Work closely with central sales & marketing teams on branding, digital presence, and promotions. Build strong relationships with travel agents, corporates, wedding planners, and local partners. 
 5. Human Resources & Team Development Recruit, train, and retain a multi-skilled, service-oriented resort team. Build a positive, disciplined, and performance-driven work culture. Manage manpower planning, duty rosters, productivity, and staff accommodation where applicable. Conduct regular training, appraisals, and succession planning. 
 6. Asset, Maintenance & Safety Management Maintain high standards of upkeep for rooms, public areas, landscaping, lake-facing zones, and back-of-house areas. Oversee preventive maintenance, AMC contracts, and capex projects. Ensure safety of guests and associates, including fire safety, water safety, and monsoon preparedness. 
 7. Owner & Stakeholder Communication Act as the primary point of contact for ownership and corporate office. Provide regular updates on operational performance, financials, and guest feedback. Ensure alignment between owner expectations, brand standards, and operational realities. Preferred candidate profile & Qualifications Graduate / Postgraduate in Hotel Management or Hospitality-related discipline. 10-15 years of hospitality experience , with at least 4-6 years as a Resort Manager or General Manager . Prior experience in destination resorts, hill stations, or leisure properties preferred. Strong exposure to weddings, events, and experiential hospitality is an advantage. Key Skills & Competencies Strong leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving approach. Excellent financial acumen and operational understanding. Guest-centric mindset with strong interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a remote / destination location and manage seasonal demand. High integrity, maturity, and ownership mindset. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR Guest satisfaction scores and online reputation F&B and events revenue growth Cost controls and GOP Employee retention and engagement Reporting Structure Reports to: Vice President - Corporate Office Saj Hotels & Resorts Direct Reports: Department Heads, Unit Heads, and Supervisors Role & responsibilities

Key Skills: Hotel Manager,Lead Operations,Process Management,Business Operations,Operations Management,Operations Planning,Operations,Leadership
